title: The pope: Peter’s chair and infallibility
tagline: What the papacy is, what infallibility means (and does not), and how it developed.
whyItMatters: The papacy is the most misunderstood Catholic teaching, and it is where Catholics, Orthodox and Protestants most differ. A clear grasp avoids caricature on both sides.

mindset.tip: Say first what infallibility is not: it is not sinlessness or a claim that every papal word is guaranteed.
Listen to Orthodox friends; their objection is to jurisdiction more than to Rome’s honour.
Begin from Matthew 16:18-19, Luke 22:31-32 and John 21:15-17, and ask what they mean. (CCC 552-553)
Admit that bad popes existed; the promise is about teaching, not holiness.
